declarations.name: AuiMultiSelect
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI MultiSelect: `<aui-multi-select>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.
Templates: AuiItem (`@absoluteui/angular/templates`).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: { value, label, disabled?, description? } with unique values.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name: one hidden input per selected value.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Input placeholder while nothing is selected (never replaces the label).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: At least one value; value-missing after touch or reportValidity().

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the input, toggle, and chip remove buttons.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Shows the value; the list does not open and chips have no remove buttons.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Consumer-managed invalid state (shown immediately).

inputs.name: errorMessage
inputs.description: Message shown when invalid is true (text only).

inputs.name: maxSelected
inputs.description: Most values that can be selected (integer >= 1); unselected options become unavailable once reached, and reaching it is announced.

inputs.name: selectAll
inputs.description: A "Select all" option that toggles every enabled option shown (up to maxSelected).

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Diacritic- and case-insensitive filtering of options while typing.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close the list after each toggle.

inputs.name: openOnFocus
inputs.description: Open the list when the input gains focus or is clicked.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Messages and filtering locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Popup alignment.

inputs.name: renderOption
inputs.description: Custom option content; the label stays the accessible name. Nodes are released with releaseNode when dropped.

inputs.name: loadOptions
inputs.description: Load options for the typed text instead of filtering options; debounced, aborted by a newer query or closing; loading and errors are shown and announced.

inputs.name: loadDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and loadOptions (0 to 5000).

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the selection (option, Select all, chip remove, or Backspace).

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: The user edited the input text.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the listbox is shown.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox pattern (editable, list autocomplete, no automatic selection) with a multi-selectable listbox; selected values as a list of chips with remove buttons.

limitations: Strict selection: values are always options; free text is never a value and is cleared when focus leaves.
No virtualization: all filtered options are rendered.
Chip remove buttons are in the tab order (one stop per selected value); Backspace in the empty input removes the last value.
Select all acts on the options shown (after filtering or loading), up to maxSelected.
